race.comment: CUSHIONED (5) was just out of the money when resuming two runs back then again narrowly missed the frame last start over 1600m at Cranbourne, beaten 1.3 lengths into fourth. Perfectly placed and is sure to prove tough to beat now at peak fitness. PERFECT NIGHT (7) showed good early speed and raced on the pace last start before fading to finish fourth, beaten 2.25 lengths, over 1400m at this track. Ready for this trip now and must be included among the main hopes. JENNI YOU THINK (6) is struggling to find the winners' circle but has been around the mark, last start finishing third over 1600m at this track. Has a win and two minor placings at this trip from three starts so she is a leading contender. BILLYCART (12) could not have been more impressive on debut and rises in grade here but looks to have upside. KIWI JENNI (11) has been thereabouts recently, the latest result a fourth beaten 2.75 lengths at Geelong over 1765m. Blinkers come off. Expected to be competitive.
